app.name: Motor accident compensation estimate
app.draft: Draft prototype. Not yet reviewed by our legal reviewers: do not rely on these numbers.
footer.private: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing you enter is stored or sent anywhere.
footer.notAdvice: This is an estimate of your legal entitlement on the facts you enter, not legal advice and not a prediction of what a tribunal will award.
footer.aid: Free legal help: your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), or the NALSA helpline 15100.
start.lead: Enter the facts of the accident. The estimate follows the Supreme Court's method, shows every head and its source, and tells you what you need to prove.
start.p1.b: The number is what the Supreme Court's method gives on your facts. Tribunals can award less or more, depending on what is proved.
start.p2.b: Each amount links to the judgment or official order it comes from. Open checks are listed publicly.
start.p3.b: Checked against 226 Delhi tribunal awards (2024–26). Where the tribunal's own findings could be re-computed, the arithmetic matched in 187 of 192 (97%).
f.claimFiledDate.help: Leave empty if no claim has been filed yet.
f.state: State where the claim is filed
f.state.help: Minimum wages are loaded for Delhi and the Central sphere only. For other states, an estimate needs proof of income.
f.state.other: Another state (minimum wage not loaded yet)
f.role.driver_of_involved_vehicle: Driving or riding one of the vehicles involved
f.vehicle: The vehicle that caused the accident
f.s164: Has any no-fault compensation (section 164) been taken?
f.s164.accepted_via_insurer: Yes, through the insurance company's settlement
f.age: Age at the time of the accident
f.emp.permanent: Permanent job (government or regular, with increments)
f.occupation.help: Used to pick the minimum-wage category when income cannot be proved.
f.monthlyTax.help: Leave empty and it is estimated from the tax slabs for that year.
f.itr: Income in the latest return before the accident (₹ a year)
f.claimed: Monthly income the family says they earned (₹)
f.claimed.help: Without documents, tribunals usually take the state minimum wage instead.
f.familyPension: Family pension now paid to the family (₹ a month)
f.spouse: Is the husband or wife a claimant?
f.children: Number of children who are claimants
f.parents: Number of parents who are claimants
f.dependentParents: Parents who depended on the person
f.cashless: Of which paid under the cashless treatment scheme (₹)
f.certificatePct: Permanent disability in the medical certificate (%)
f.basis.limb: One limb or part of the body
f.workCapacity: Can the person do their earlier work?
res.rangeWide: The contested points move this a lot: read what could move it, below.
res.spread: How far real awards land: in {n} {kind} awards ({label}), half came between {lo} and {hi} an estimate like this (about {a} to {b} here). This reflects evidence and practice, not your legal entitlement.
res.head: Head
res.working: Working figures (not added to the total)
res.swing.lead: Each contested point, one at a time, and what it is worth.
res.swing.down: If the tribunal takes the conservative view
res.swing.up: If it takes the claimant's view
res.prove: What you will need to prove
res.prove.note: Documents tribunals usually ask for. To be confirmed by our legal reviewers.
res.interest.lead: Tribunals add simple interest from the date of filing, usually 6–9% a year. It is not in the number above.
res.cases.lead: Public judgments with similar facts, and what happened at each stage.
res.cases.none: No sufficiently similar case in the library yet.
res.cases.years: {y} years from accident to final amount
res.next.1: Free legal help: the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in your district, or the NALSA helpline 15100.
res.next.2: Do not accept no-fault compensation (section 164) through the insurance company's settlement without advice: it ends the claim for full compensation.
res.next.3: Claims must be filed within six months of the accident; the Supreme Court has directed that, for now, claims should not be dismissed as late.
res.next.4: Advocates may not charge a percentage of the award.
res.offer: Check an insurance offer against this estimate
res.none.lead: On these facts the calculator cannot give a number. The reason is below.
prove.fir: FIR and the police Detailed Accident Report (DAR)
prove.heirs: Proof of the family members (ration card, Aadhaar, legal-heir certificate)
prove.age: Proof of age (Aadhaar, school certificate, or the post-mortem report)
prove.salary: Salary slips, appointment letter, bank statements showing salary, Form 16
prove.itr: Income-tax returns for the three years before the accident
prove.claimed: Any evidence of the income claimed (employer letter, bank statements, witnesses); otherwise the minimum wage is used
prove.pension: Pension payment order and family pension order
prove.medical: Medical bills, prescriptions and discharge summaries
prove.disability: Disability certificate from a medical board, and evidence of how it affects the person's work (functional disability)
prove.offwork: Proof of time off work (employer letter, medical advice)
prove.vehicle: Registration, insurance policy and driving licence of the vehicle (usually in the police file)
offer.lead: An offer paid now is compared with the estimated award later, including interest, time and fees.
offer.need: First make an estimate, then come back to check an offer against it.
offer.years: Years until an award (if the offer is refused)
offer.interest: Interest the tribunal would add (% a year)
offer.discount: Value of money now vs later (% a year)
offer.pctStd: The offer is {p}% of the estimated entitlement
offer.award: Estimated award with interest after {y} years
offer.pv: What waiting is worth today, after fees
offer.vsPv: The offer is {p}% of what waiting is worth today
offer.caveat: Insurer offers in published Delhi awards were a median 9% of the final award, but those were offers families refused. Accepted offers are not published.
err.future: This date cannot be in the future.
err.beforeAccident: The claim cannot be filed before the accident.
err.cashless: Cannot be more than the medical bills.
state.UP: Uttar Pradesh (minimum wage not loaded yet)
state.MP: Madhya Pradesh (minimum wage not loaded yet)
state.CENTRAL: Central sphere rates, construction schedule (fallback only)
elig.title: This changes what can be claimed
elig.owner: An owner-driver hurt with no other vehicle involved has no third-party (section 166) claim. Check the vehicle's personal accident cover.
elig.unidentified: When the vehicle is not identified, compensation is claimed under the hit-and-run scheme (section 161), not through this estimate.
elig.s164: Accepting no-fault compensation through the insurance company's settlement ends the claim for full compensation (section 166).
res.cases.disclaimer: Real, public judgments. Every case turns on its own evidence: these show what happened, not what you will get.
head.pain_suffering_amenities: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities
